set.body:
Owner: fit/profile. Acceptance:
- Recover every signed trial amplitude and arithmetic condition mean at prepared shapes against original penalized equations for both backends.
- At decoded shapes use one directional first-order solve and one fixed second-order residual correction; include nuisance coefficients consistently and demonstrate O(||delta||^3) error under admitted smoothness/conditioning.
- Check original normal equations or include complete interpolation/tail error; bound coefficient energy with eta<1 and label pointwise/empirical/certified evidence honestly.
- Separate forward/adjoint readout tests precede fused backward filters; compare fused/unfused outputs, indexing and off-grid injection.
- Adaptive y->a(thetaHat(y)) never masquerades as global linear LSS TrialReadout. Preserve trial axis and no OLS uncertainty inference. JVM+JS tests.
Performance: one correction maximum, at most one extra certification solve. Do not retain N*d*V fields; finite-state readout uses block innovations and O(N) terminal output visits. Report certification cost.

Specification: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md (SHA256 bb6b56efab0d251b287ec0d315112103c2213434a489625def8c2ccc9b35293c). Research probe: tools/validation/profile_hrf_review.py (SHA256 03be9eab54b76c0076ced2fe4deb26ab00fe4259536284833ae53971a5a61c9d). These are local review artifacts, not a released estimator. The source proposal numerical tables were unavailable; only independently reproduced checks count as evidence.
set.title: PHRF-11: Add exact prepared-shape and bounded directional trial readout
